label: ProLiant DL360 Gen10 1U rack server
description: 1U two-socket rack server with four embedded 1GbE ports (HPE 331i) and a 1GbE dedicated iLO 5 port. One FlexibleLOM slot takes the primary 10/25GbE adapter without consuming a PCIe slot.
notes: Onboard: 4x 1GbE HPE 331i embedded. 'Network Choice' (NC) SKUs ship with no embedded LOM and require a FlexibleLOM instead - this spec is the embedded-LOM CTO build. FlexibleLOM is the 10/25GbE uplink slot; 3x PCIe 3.0 slots for stand-up cards. iLO 5 port is 1GbE dedicated.
